what_is_wrong: The block seepage_only -> permeability reports spearman 0.548 with an interval of 0.55 to 0.854 and passes: true. That interval does not contain its own estimate and must not be used. Eight of the nine seepage-only tests share one model rate (19.08), so the 'order' rests on a single test, and 3,501 of the 10,000 resamples had no order at all and were skipped.
what_to_read_instead: No interval and no pass or fail for that block. The primary result (all 16 unlined tests, permeability: 0.578, interval 0.234 to 0.775) is not affected; a code review reproduced it, and dropping any one test leaves it between 0.51 and 0.63.
code_change: ponding.rank_agreement now returns no interval when the model gives fewer than three different rates across the tests.
found_by: code audit after the result was published; reports/decision.md already said this interval was not reliable and not used.
